# Center Island Performance Athletics

> > Sports performance training and injury prevention center on Long Island led by Dr. Steven Macagnone, specializing in athletic development, biomechanics analysis, and concussion screening for youth and collegiate athletes.

Center Island Performance Athletics operates locations in Jericho and East Northport, NY, serving Nassau and Suffolk County athletes. The center focuses on evidence-based training methods, baseline testing, and sport-specific biomechanics education to optimize athletic performance and reduce injury risk.

## Sports Biomechanics & Technique

- [Biomechanics of the Lacrosse Pass](http://www.centerislandperformanceathletics.com/2016/03/biomechanics-of-lacrosse-pass.html): Analysis of lacrosse passing technique and overhead swing mechanics
- [Biomechanics of the Lacrosse Shot](http://www.centerislandperformanceathletics.com/2016/03/biomechanics-of-lacrosse-shot.html): Breakdown of lacrosse shooting biomechanics and movement phases

## Injury Prevention & Posture

- [The Importance of Posture in Sports Performance](http://www.centerislandperformanceathletics.com/2016/04/the-importance-of-posture-in-sports.html): How proper posture and body alignment enhance athletic performance
- [Sitting, Slouching, and Sport: The Thoracic Spine](http://www.centerislandperformanceathletics.com/2016/03/sitting-slouching-and-sport-thoracic.html): Thoracic spine health, posture issues, and sports injury prevention
